pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by the PEDIA Tape.
Focus on rapid and early BLS airway and ventilation tools. Intubation may not be the best
Pediatric pads should be used in children < 10 Kg or PEDIA tape color purple.
xygenation and ventilation, begin chest compressions and CPR
Continue to address specific signs, symptoms, and/or dysrhythmia.

pl1: Adult & Pediatric - Airway Management and Oxygen
Adult & Pediatric - Fluid bolus with Isotonic Solution as needed
pl2: Adult- Simple Thoracostomy (only in cardiac arrest)
Adult – Calcium Chloride, Sodium Bicarbonate, and Albuterol
